rationale: The artifacts consistently present the DAA architecture as a provisional project proposal and illustrative hypothesis, explicitly disclaiming it as an approved design or certified safety evidence. The challenge to stress-test shared perception failures is actively addressed in the architecture document, visual inventory, and script outlines, which emphasize that a monitor sharing the same blind world model fails to provide independent safety assurance.
limitations: The architecture remains a theoretical project proposal; its mapping to specific regulatory objectives (like EASA DS.AI or FAA standards) requires separately inspected clause-level evidence.
